A '''leatherwing''' was an [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creature found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Leatherwings had dull, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and huge, membranous [[Limb/Legends|wings]]. Leatherwings would on occasion fly to the southern part of Ord Mantell for warmer [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], and were too small to cause a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] blip on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Leatherwings first appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
